summary.text: Amy Amin is the Democratic candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 68 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Mike Clines.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a small business owner and lifelong Campbell County resident.

paragraphs.text: Amy Amin graduated from Highlands High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Northern Kentucky University.
Her career experience includes working in business, and in a Ballotpedia survey she described herself as a small business owner and community advocate who serves her local school.
In the survey, Amin said her campaign is focused on bringing people together to serve Campbell County as one community.
She listed fiscal responsibility and local economic growth, affordable healthcare, and support for public education as her policy priorities.
She named the Kentucky Women's Network PAC and the AFL-CIO as endorsers.
